reviewNotes: Montages, captions and complete native diagrams reviewed. This is the preliminary drawing sideline at22 seconds, not verification of the main e5 winning plan. Native8 shows the complete seven-piece position after Rxe6: White Kg2/Re6/f2 against Kf4/Rd4/f5/g4, Black to move. The board is reversed: Black king is on f4, not g4. White’s original f4 pawn and Black’s e6 pawn have actually been captured; neither a2 nor an extra pawn is silently dropped. Both teaching branches below are independent representative continuations after this source diagram. Every root, intermediate position and endpoint has saved exact tablebase evidence. The original ten-piece root, the Ra4/Ra5 timing, e5/fxe5 and the main king-shelter winning conversion remain outside this selected draw lesson.
